subject.title: fix(install): bound download_file curl with connect and max-time limits

question: Should the installers introduce a curl-specific 10-second connection-phase deadline, or should any new curl connection bound follow the existing wget 20-second network-timeout policy while preserving main's 30-second low-speed grace window?
rationale: The current code intentionally distinguishes a 30-second curl post-connect stall allowance from wget's 20-second DNS/connect/idle limits, so selecting a new curl connection deadline is an upgrade-sensitive installer policy choice rather than a mechanical timeout cleanup.

options.title: Preserve 30 seconds and align connection policy
options.body: Rebase the PR, keep `--speed-time 30`, and choose a connection deadline only after comparing curl's broader DNS/TLS connection phase with wget's existing 20-second contract.

options.title: Accept the proposed 10-second connect limit
options.body: Treat a 10-second curl DNS/TLS connection deadline and a 20-second low-speed grace period as an intentional compatibility change, with explicit upgrade proof.

options.title: Defer the new connection deadline
options.body: Keep current main's low-speed protection and close or narrow this PR if the repository does not want a new curl connection-phase failure mode.

recommendation.title: Preserve 30 seconds and align connection policy
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, keep `--speed-time 30`, and choose a connection deadline only after comparing curl's broader DNS/TLS connection phase with wget's existing 20-second contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the current shared installer timeout policy; local history attribution was unavailable in the read-only environment.
